features: Hassle-Free Type-C Charging: Presenting India’s first smartwatch with Type-C charging. Marking a quantum leap in smartwatch design, boAt Storm Call 4 brings the much-awaited convenience of Type-C charging to smartwatches. It instantly zeros the cable clutter from your ecosystem, letting you use the exact same Type-C cable that powers your phone or laptop.

1.96” (4.97 cm) HD Display: Equipped with a 1.96” high-definition display, Storm Call 4 offers clear visibility in any lighting condition. Whether you are checking workout stats mid-run or reading notifications on your watch, with 240 × 282 HD resolution and 500 nits peak brightness, every pixel pops on a big bright display.

Functional Crown: Switch between multiple menu styles and glide through endless features with a simple tactile twist using the Functional Crown. It makes navigation a cakewalk, letting you adjust settings or change watch faces without ever blocking your display view.

IP68 Waterproofing: Water ingress is history with IP68 dust and splash resistance. Built with a completely sealed design, Storm Call 4 easily braves unexpected dust storms, sweaty workouts, and everyday accidental spills.

Multiple Sports Modes: Whether you're hitting the cricket pitch, running indoors, or practising yoga, dedicated workout modes track every single calorie burnt by your body. With Storm Call 4 on your wrist, just select your sports mode and let the watch do the rest, featuring strength training, football, cricket, yoga, and golf, to name a few, along with auto-activity detection for running and walking.

Advanced Bluetooth Calling: Stay connected on the go and manage your calls directly from your wrist, whether you're driving, on a morning run, or busy with household chores. The watch features a loud built-in speaker, a crystal-clear mic, a responsive dial pad, and the ability to save your frequently dialled contacts.

24X7 Heart Rate & SpO2 Monitoring: Built with advanced health sensors, Storm Call 4 tracks your vitals continuously. You can start real-time heart rate measurements to view your current beats per minute (BPM), minimum BPM, and peak workout zones. Combined with real-time blood oxygen (SpO2) saturation tracking, it helps you stay deeply aware of your health for your long-term wellness.

Sleep Tracking: With Storm Call 4 on your wrist at night, you can measure the true quality of your rest. The watch tracks your sleep cycles in comprehensive detail, giving you a breakdown of Deep Sleep, Light Sleep, REM Sleep, and Awake time, helping you understand your sleep patterns better.

Stress Monitoring & Guided Breathing: It also gently tracks your maximum and minimum stress levels throughout the day to help you understand your lifestyle patterns. And, when things get overwhelming, use Guided Breathing mode to take a mindful pause and restore your inner peace.

Emergency SOS and Unlimited Utilities: Packed with an instantaneous emergency SOS, a quick three taps on the power button at once dial your pre-saved emergency contact. Moreover, you can command your voice assistant anytime, control music playback and camera shutter remotely, check live weather updates, set daily alarms and timers, or pass the time with games, keeping all your digital essentials just a tap away.
